name: Camp Hale
description_short: Overnight camp on Squam Lake in Sandwich, NH, run by Boston's United South End Settlements for Boston youth ages 5–17. It offers boys, girls and all-gender sessions, leadership programs for teens, and a 4-day Family Camp, with bus transport from Boston and fees on a sliding scale.
refund_policy_summary: All payments are final and non-refundable. Payment plans are available if you contact the camp.
swim_waterfront_notes: On Squam Lake. The camp aims for 2–4 swim sessions a day and to teach every child to swim and be water-safe. Canoeing, kayaking and paddle boarding are also offered.

warnings: The page only lists the 2026 season, and all 2026 sessions have already happened (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 are not posted yet.

Fees use a sliding scale based on household income: $142–$2,625 for a 2-week session and $100.82–$1,863.75 for the 'Co-Ed Session Rate'. A family's actual fee is set after the camp checks its income. Prices for individual sessions are left blank for this reason.
The sliding-scale table is labeled 'Household Size' but its columns show income ranges only.
The page says 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-week programs exist and mentions 'Rookie Camp' in the FAQ, but the 2026 schedule shows only 2-week sessions, one 7-day session and Family Camp.
No dates are given for the LIT program (age 15, 4 weeks) or the CIT program (ages 16–17, 4 weeks).
Family Camp has no price listed.
A day option without the overnight stay is available only to New Hampshire residents, who must contact the camp to arrange it.
